content.comment_body: I've been using the new [version_no] of [product_name] software and have a question about simulation mode. I completed converting my application to use the new display feature but do not have the actual hardware yet to test it. Is it possible to preview how the updated text display will appear while using the simulation function in the software?

Hello [user_name], At a trade fair in April, I saw a version of [product_name] that displayed the output in simulation mode. I heard this feature would be added via a future service pack, potentially later this year, along with improvements like enhanced bar graphs and PI outputs. However, I haven't found any updates about this on the official website or through online searches. We'll have to wait for further news.

analysis.insight_summary: Users would like to preview updated display features for [product_name] modules directly in the simulation mode of the software. Currently, this option isn't available, resulting in developers lacking immediate feedback when working without the actual hardware. Rumors suggest future updates will provide this functionality, but there's no official release date or confirmation yet.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to view new text displays and related outputs during simulation in the [product_name] software, rather than needing access to the physical device.
